name: Orkim Berhad
overview: 2026年，Orkim Berhad 的公告主要涉及公司秘书变更、地址变更、股息除权安排及股东大会等事项，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为87,335,000令吉，净利润为22,906,000令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, Orkim Berhad's announcements mainly covered changes of company secretary, change of address, dividend ex-date arrangements and general meetings, with no disclosure of expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract wins in any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 87,335,000 and net profit was MYR 22,906,000.
